messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — need a short decision thread on launch scope + surge mitigations for the multi-model routing feature. Proposal below, please react/sign off by EOD.

Maya (PM): TL;DR — phased launch: 1) US-EAST canary (5% traffic) w/ live fallbacks, 2) EU shadowing only, 3) wider ramp after telemetry gates. Restrict model mix for v1 to core LLM + quantized small fallback.

Aj (Eng): +1 on phased. What are the exact telemetry gates?

Maya (PM): Gates I'm proposing: p95 latency < 350ms (api-gen), error-rate < 0.5% (5xx+model-errors), cost-per-1000-tokens <= $X (ops target). Also no catastrophic retries > 1% of requests.

Lucy (SRE): Can we get observability hooks in the canary to surface per-tenant token spikes? Need per-tenant SLA guardrail.

Aj (Eng): We'll add token-rate + token-burst counters and per-tenant circuit-breaker. Implementation plan: feature flag gate + routing table tweak. Canary will have continuous sampling to telemetry pipeline.

Sam (Product Ops): For customer-facing opt-ins: default to OFF for enterprise tenants. We can enable by request for early partners (Carlos can coordinate). Public beta for self-serve later.

Carlos (Sales): That works. A couple of larger accounts asked about privacy: must ensure EU traffic doesn't route through US models during shadow.

Aj (Eng): EU shadowing will run on EU model variants and only shadow (no writeback). We'll pin region routing and disable cross-region fallbacks for v1.

Ruth (Design): For A/B tests on UI, can we keep the change minimal? We'll surface a neutral banner for participants. Need flag to control sampling rate client-side.

Maya (PM): Yes — A/B will be 10% of canary traffic to validate UX. Non-participants see existing UI.

Lucy (SRE): Fallback policy idea: if token TPS exceeds X or queue latency > Y, automatically switch tenant to "reduced feature set" (small-model only) and emit alert. Is that acceptable?

Aj (Eng): That's the plan. Fallback tiers: 1) small-model quantized (compatible response shape), 2) rate-limit soft (graceful degradation), 3) full block for abusive patterns. We'll implement automatic routing policy + manual override.

Maya (PM): Short example flag setup (will push to flagstore):
```
flag: multi_model_routing_v1
scopes: global, tenant:opt-in
canary_pct: 5
eu_shadow: true
fallback_policy: small_model_then_rate_limit
```

Aj (Eng): +1 on schema. We'll also emit a `fallback_reason` field in logs to trace events.

Lucy (SRE): Add two critical alarms to the runbook: 1) sustained p95 > 400ms for 2 minutes, 2) fallback_count > 50/min. Both should page on-call and create a ticket.

Maya (PM): Agree. Also add a cost alarm: hourly cost delta > 20% vs baseline -> alert to finance & eng.

Sam (Product Ops): Rollout playbook items: preflight checklist (capacity check, flag created, telemetry hook, rollback code path tested), canary monitor dashboard link, stakeholder notify list.

Maya (PM): I'll draft the preflight and postmortem template. For acceptance: engineering signoff on fallback and observability, SRE signoff on alarms/playbook, product ops on comms.

Aj (Eng): Engineering signoff pending: will run integration tests for fallback and the per-tenant circuit breaker by tomorrow morning.

Lucy (SRE): SRE signoff pending until runbook includes manual kill-switch steps and contact list. I'll review after Aj's tests.

Ruth (Design): UX approved for minimal A/B banner. Need copy — will send in thread.

Carlos (Sales): I'll shortlist two early partners for opt-in: Acme & Nova. Will coordinate legal for EU shadow.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC (canary only). Please ensure preflight items are green before that window.

Maya (PM): Request: thumbs up reaction if you acknowledge responsibility for your action item. I'll collate EOD and lock the canary window.

Aj (Eng): :+1: I own engineering tests.

Lucy (SRE): :eyes: I will fill in runbook details.

Sam (Product Ops): :+1: I'll publish the rollout checklist and notify comms.

Carlos (Sales): :+1: Partner coordination.

Ruth (Design): :+1: UX copy will land before EOD.

Maya (PM): Great — action items condensed: 1) Aj: integration tests + flag config, 2) Lucy: runbook + alarms, 3) Sam: rollout checklist + dashboards, 4) Carlos: partner EU legal + opt-in list, 5) Ruth: banner copy.

Maya (PM): If any blocking items surface by 18:00 PT we move the deploy to next window. Otherwise we'll proceed with the scheduled canary.

Aj (Eng): noted. If we hit token burst profile in perf test, will post results here immediately.

Lucy (SRE): Will validate alert routes and escalation policy.

Maya (PM): Thanks all. Closing thread; will post final checklist link once Sam publishes.

Sam (Product Ops): checklist: https://internal.redwood/rollouts/multi-model-routing/v1 (draft) :lock:

Maya (PM): :rocket:
